title: Connectors
intro: New in WordPress 7.1: Connectors is a shared store of API keys and credentials (Akismet, Anthropic, Google, OpenAI…) that plugins such as the AI plugin use, so a key is configured once and used everywhere.
backdrop: Backdrop core has no shared credential store or AI integration. Contrib modules add provider-specific settings pages.

links.description: search for AI, spam protection and API integrations
